title: 最大相等频率
summary: 求最长前缀，使从中删除恰好一个元素后，剩余每个不同数值的出现次数都相同。
insight: 维护每个值的频次以及“频次的频次”和当前最大频次。一个前缀合法只有三种形态：所有值只出现一次；恰有一个只出现一次；或恰有一个值比其余值多出现一次。
pitfalls: 删除后可以只剩一种数值
每次更新值频次时先减少旧频次桶
答案取所有合法前缀中的最长

solutions.title: 数值频次与频次桶
solutions.idea: 用三个等式常数时间判断当前前缀形态。
steps: valueCount 记录值频次，frequencyCount 记录有多少值具有某频次，maximum 为最大频次
加入 value 时从旧频次桶减一，新频次桶加一并更新 maximum
长度 len 合法若 maximum==1，或 maximum*frequencyCount[maximum]+1==len，或 (maximum-1)*(frequencyCount[maximum-1]+1)+1==len；合法则记录 len

code.java: class Solution { public int maxEqualFreq(int[] nums){Map<Integer,Integer> valueCount=new HashMap<>(),frequencyCount=new HashMap<>();int maximum=0,answer=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){int old=valueCount.getOrDefault(nums[i],0);if(old>0)frequencyCount.put(old,frequencyCount.get(old)-1);int current=old+1;valueCount.put(nums[i],current);frequencyCount.put(current,frequencyCount.getOrDefault(current,0)+1);maximum=Math.max(maximum,current);int length=i+1;if(maximum==1||maximum*frequencyCount.getOrDefault(maximum,0)+1==length||(maximum-1)*(frequencyCount.getOrDefault(maximum-1,0)+1)+1==length)answer=length;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxEqualFreq(nums:IntArray):Int{val valueCount=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();val frequencyCount=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();var maximum=0;var answer=0;for(i in nums.indices){val old=valueCount[nums[i]]?:0;if(old>0)frequencyCount[old]=(frequencyCount[old]?:0)-1;val current=old+1;valueCount[nums[i]]=current;frequencyCount[current]=(frequencyCount[current]?:0)+1;maximum=maxOf(maximum,current);val length=i+1;if(maximum==1||maximum*(frequencyCount[maximum]?:0)+1==length||(maximum-1)*((frequencyCount[maximum-1]?:0)+1)+1==length)answer=length};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxEqualFreq(vector<int>& nums){unordered_map<int,int> valueCount,frequencyCount;int maximum=0,answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i){int old=valueCount[nums[i]];if(old)--frequencyCount[old];int current=++valueCount[nums[i]];++frequencyCount[current];maximum=max(maximum,current);int length=i+1;if(maximum==1||maximum*frequencyCount[maximum]+1==length||(maximum-1)*(frequencyCount[maximum-1]+1)+1==length)answer=length;}return answer;} };
